description: This file defines the ReviewRequest Data Transfer Object (DTO) used for creating or updating a review within the application. It contains fields for employee ID, reviewer name, rating, and comments, along with their respective getters and setters. The class is annotated for validation and API schema documentation.

classes.name: ReviewRequest
classes.description: A DTO class representing the data required to create or update a review.

methods.name: getEmployeeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the employee being reviewed.

methods.name: getReviewerName
methods.description: Returns the name of the reviewer.

methods.name: getRating
methods.description: Returns the rating score for the review.

methods.name: getComments
methods.description: Returns the comments associated with the review.
